checks.name: the mode vocabulary is the one the preset and the menu speak
the field is half the canvas, clamped to 256..640 wide and >= 128 tall
a footprint covers ~1.2 mean inter-star spacings, clamped 2.5..40 px
the splat uniform is radius, fieldW, fieldH, 1 pc floor
every visible record is sampled when the population is under the cap
height mode reads log10 distance in kpc and brackets the sample
the display window is padded by 4% of the span plus 0.02 dex, with a 0.3 dex floor
spread mode reports a positive σ of the log distances
slope mode reports dex per degree and stays finite on a degenerate ray
a star at the camera is floored at 1 pc (log10 = -3), not -∞
the estimators survive a two-star sample
fewer than three visible records falls back to the declared window
FLAG_VISIBLE gates the range sample
a refresh reuses the same scratch arrays (no per-frame allocation)
the composite uniform is params, range, viewport (field size + tan(fovY/2))
look knobs clamp instead of leaking into the shader
the height legend quotes the ramp ends in kpc
the spread legend quotes σ in dex and the slope legend dex/deg
the off mode has no active legend
the island painter and the overlay sample the same five LUTs
auto picks viridis for distance, turbo for spread, grey for anything else
the GPU ramp is a 256×4 byte view of the same LUT with opaque alpha
